dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing at the moment?

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Huh? Well, oh, nothing. Just wondering about some new uses for kuuvahki. Like, if we could upgrade this forging machine with it...

dialogues.speaker: Lyulka
dialogues.text: Of course, there aren't many craftpeople in Nod-Krai that can hope to stand up to "it" these days... Except for Aino, of course... Yeah, just Aino...
